typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoTradeLifecycleCaptureExecutionTime_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		KEYWORD_NAME as string,
		EXECUTIONDATETIME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromCALYPSODBAtradekeyword
fromCALYPSODBAtradekeyword derive({Copy of KEYWORD_NAME} = KEYWORD_NAME,
		{Copy of EXECUTIONDATETIME} = EXECUTIONDATETIME,
		{Copy of TRADE_ID} = TRADE_ID) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		trade_id as string,
		keyword_value as string,
		keyword_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		trade_id = TRADE_ID,
		keyword_value = {Copy of EXECUTIONDATETIME},
		keyword_name = {Copy of KEYWORD_NAME}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoTradeLifecycleCaptureExecutionTime_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoTradeLifecycleCaptureExecutionTime
